target.statement: IDS-Anta++ accuracy of 0.845 on CIC-IDS-2017 under FGSM adversarial attack (the headline robustness gain over undefended DNN at 0.720)

compute.basis: CIC-IDS-2017 CSV (~2.8M flows, 80 features) must be downloaded and preprocessed (Z-score + SVD to 50 dims), six classifiers (RF, SVM, LR, DNN, XGBoost, LightGBM) trained, then FGSM on the DNN and the three-layer defense pipeline run; all CPU-feasible but SVM on millions of rows and the full protocol push it to a few hours.

blockers: Repo link is a bare user profile plus a repo whose contents are unverified; no configs/scripts confirmed to reproduce Table 4
FGSM/ZOO attack implementation and exact preprocessing (SVD k, Isolation Forest threshold tau, median window) are described only in prose, not as runnable configs
CIC-IDS-2017 is large (~2.8M rows) and SVM training on it is slow on CPU
Exact train/test split and label binarization for the multi-class 2017 setting are unspecified
title: SHIELD-IDS: Structurally Heterogeneous Ensemble with Integrated Layered Defense for Intrusion Detection Systems
